subject: Matemática
description_pt: Resolver problemas que envolvam a noção de ângulo em diferentes contextos e em situações reais, como ângulo de visão.

components.description_pt: Interpretar o conceito de ângulo em contextos reais como campo de visão
components.description_en: Interpret the concept of angle in real-world contexts such as field of vision

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas envolvendo medidas de ângulos em diferentes situações reais
components.description_en: Solve problems involving angle measures in different real-world situations
components.cc_component_description: Draw geometric shapes with given conditions (side lengths, angle measures, radius/diameter)

cc_matches.description: Draw (freehand, with ruler and protractor, and with technology) geometric shapes with given conditions. Focus on constructing triangles from three measures of angles or sides, noticing when the conditions determine a unique triangle, more than one triangle, or no triangle.
